title: Quality Director
text:
We are a fast-paced business with ambitious growth plans; so if you are dedicated, enthusiastic and always seeking ways to improve, you'll enjoy a career with us!
 
 
Director of Quality
 
 
**Weston - Florida, USA | Permanent | Full-time**
**About Ontic Weston**
Weston is Ontic's newest site and an important part of the next stage of our growth in the US.
 
 
Acquired in 2026, the 130,000 sq ft facility will become a dedicated Original Equipment production site, complementing our MRO Center of Excellence in nearby Miramar. Together, our two South Florida locations give Ontic the space and capability to continue expanding as customer demand grows.
 
 
Joining Weston at this stage means more than joining a new facility. You'll have the opportunity to help build it - shaping teams, ways of working and culture as we prepare the site for operations in 2027. If you're energised by growth, change and the chance to create something from the ground up, this is a rare opportunity to do exactly that.
 
 
The opportunity
 
 
Lead Quality for an aerospace manufacturing operation where reliability and customer confidence are fundamental. At Weston, you'll shape the way quality is built into products and processes while supporting a growing site's operational priorities.
 
 
You'll lead Quality Engineering, Quality Control and inspection activities, working with operations and external stakeholders to strengthen compliance, resolve complex issues and drive lasting improvements in product and process quality.
 
 
What you'll be doing
 
 

* Lead and develop Quality Engineering, Quality Control and inspection teams, setting clear expectations and priorities.
* Develop, install and then maintain effective quality management systems and applicable aerospace certification requirements.
* Represent Quality with customers and government quality representatives, resolving issues constructively.
* Oversee quality planning, contract reviews, audits, material review activity and corrective actions.
* Partner across functions on new products, product integration and transitions into production.
* Use quality measures and root-cause analysis to reduce defects, scrap, warranty costs and repeat issues.
* Build a culture of prevention, accountability and continuous improvement.

What you'll bring
 
 

* At least 10 years of aerospace Quality experience in an AS9100 manufacturing environment, including significant leadership responsibility.
* A bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant discipline, plus knowledge of AS9100 internal auditing.
* Experience leading Quality Engineering, Quality Control and inspection teams in high-mix aerospace manufacturing.
* Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, Federal Aviation Administration and Department of Defense requirements, and applicable contract clauses.
* Experience with audits, customer approvals, contract reviews, material review and corrective action.
* Strong structured problem-solving and executive stakeholder communication skills.
* Lean or Six Sigma experience and FAA designated manufacturing inspection representative training or certification would be advantageous.

Why Ontic?
 
 
At Ontic, we're specialists in keeping critical aircraft flying. Our work supports civil and military aviation around the world, giving established aircraft products the long-term support they need to remain safe, reliable and available.
 
 
But it's our people who make that possible. We're a growing, global team where you're trusted to take ownership, encouraged to challenge how things have always been done and supported to develop your career as our business grows.
 
 
We believe in embracing the challenge - working together to solve complex problems and create opportunities for our customers, our business and each other.
 
 
Benefits at Ontic
 
 
At Ontic, we're committed to supporting our people to thrive - at work and beyond. Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, development and financial security, while giving everyone the opportunity to share in our success.
 
 

* Goal Share bonus program - everyone at Ontic is automatically enrolled, giving us all the opportunity to share in our success
* Paid volunteering time - giving you time to support a cause or community that matters to you
* 24/7 wellbeing support - confidential support available through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Employee discounts - access to discounts and offers across a range of retailers and services
* Learning and development - opportunities to build your skills, develop your career and grow with Ontic
* Employee referral program - rewarding you for introducing great people to Team Ontic
* Comprehensive medical insurance
* Competitive PTO, holiday pay and sick leave
* 401(k) plan - with up to 4% company match
* 9/80 work schedule - where applicable

Ready to embrace the challenge?
 
 
If this sounds like the kind of opportunity where you could make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and see where a career with Team Ontic could take you.
